title: mixscore records (analysis/mixscore.jsonl)
description: Output of the opt-in analyzer plugin `mixscore` (analysis/mixscore.py, host.py --mixscore): BirdNET run on the 8-beam mean mix of each 3 s window, next to the per-beam `birds` plugin. `mixscore` = one window with at least one mix detection; `mixscore_compare` = one record per UTC minute comparing the per-beam events of the birds plugin with the mix events (definitions in specs/mixscore.md). Metadata only: no audio, no embeddings, no location. Windows the tagger flagged as speech produce no record and no count by species; human-voice labels are never written. The discriminator is `type` (new JSONL interfaces use `type`). Receivers MUST ignore unknown fields and skip a record whose `v` they do not know.

forbidden_keys.description: Privacy: a record never carries audio, an embedding or a location.

in_region.description: Same meaning as in analysis-records `bird`: null when the geo filter is off or cannot judge the label.

group.description: ui/taxa.json group stamp (bird, insect, amphibian, mammal, mechanical, other-bio) or null when the table is missing.

t.description: Window end, Unix seconds (the plugin clock, same as birds `t`).

level_dbfs.description: RMS level of the loudest beam (the gate quantity).

mix_dbfs.description: RMS level of the scored mix.

mix_gain_db.description: Gain applied to the plain 8-beam mean so the mix has the mean beam power: 0 for identical beams, 20 log10 sqrt(8) = 9.03 dB for uncorrelated beams (the cap).

n_filtered.description: Detections the location filter removed from this window's mix result (names are not recorded).

top.description: Mix detections at or above min_conf, highest confidence first, at most 5; human labels removed.

t.description: Start of the UTC minute (Unix seconds); a window belongs to the minute its end time falls in.

partial.description: Present (true) only for a minute flushed at shutdown before its grace period ended.
